title: Plumbing Repair Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Plumbing Repair: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Plumbing Repair Completion Report covers fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish. The plumbing service coordinator records Residential Plumbing Repair performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Plumbing Repair Completion Report keeps Residential Plumbing Repair exceptions visible until the plumbing service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Plumbing Repair Completion Report at residence, room, fixture, shutoff point, and affected downstream area. Document fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish identity before Residential Plumbing Repair begins. Compare fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish findings with stated Residential Plumbing Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Plumbing Repair issues to qualified plumbing service reviewer. For Plumbing Repair Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Plumbing Repair. Ask qualified plumbing service reviewer to review Residential Plumbing Repair conditions beyond the plumbing service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Plumbing Repair, identify responsible parties, residence, room, fixture, shutoff point, and affected downstream area, and the linked fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish source.

fields.label: Fixture, line, valve, appliance, or drain identifier
Leak or blockage onset, usage condition, and prior repair

sections.title: Delivered result and verification evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Plumbing Repair facts for fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Plumbing Repair completion checks
items: Active leak location, rate, and affected materials
Supply pressure, shutoff, valve, and connection condition
Drain flow, backup, trap, vent, and cleanout observation
Fixture mounting, seal, and functional behavior
Water-heating or appliance connection where in scope
Post-repair leak, flow, and drainage test

sections.title: Remaining work, evidence, and next owner
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Plumbing Repair conditions; have plumbing service coordinator assign the next Residential Plumbing Repair owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Uncontrolled water flow or contamination concern
Concealed damage or mold-like condition outside scope
Gas, electrical, structural, or utility conflict
Repair requires unavailable shutdown or authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Plumbing Repair when water control, contamination, concealed damage, utility conflict, or safe test remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Plumbing Repair proof and route unresolved fixture, supply, drain, valve, appliance connection, and affected finish scope to plumbing service coordinator.
